qAndA.answer: Overall, the video is positive and informative. It aims to challenge common misconceptions about cycling in New York City and show how enjoyable and safe it can be. There are moments of frustration when they encounter obstacles, but these are balanced by the excitement of exploring the city and the serenity of Central Park. The heartwarming interaction between Clarence and his son adds a personal touch to the video.

youtube_description:
New York City may seem like a dangerous place to ride a bike, but it's actually pretty safe. There are new bike lanes going in every day, the bike share program, Citi Bike is booming (over 12,000 bikes) and new developments are being planned with pedestrians in mind. In this video, I meet up with my buddy Clarence Eckerson Jr. for a tour of all the good stuff. Check his work out here, https://www.streetfilms.org
